children: 20/20 Biolabs presented FDA engagement progress, Medicare reimbursement opportunity and Q2 commercial growth.
Filed Exhibit 99.1 for an investor webinar on Sept 2, 2026 to present OneTest strategy and materials.
Notes Congress created a Medicare reimbursement pathway for MCED tests beginning in 2028, which could support OneTest if FDA authorization and CMS criteria are met.
Reported preliminary FDA leadership discussions and plans to pursue formal interactions, Breakthrough Device designation and real-world evidence programs.
Q2 2026 delivered the company's best quarterly cancer testing revenue to date, up 47% YoY with new accounts and large firefighter program deployments.
Emphasizes OneTest's serial biomarker velocity approach, at-home capillary collection and M&A strategy to expand distribution and capabilities.
